firstPartySourceEncoding: SHA256 of JSON.stringify of all cmd/internal Go source path and SHA256 pairs sorted by relative path; contents normalized to UTF-8 LF. All actual main-module production GoFiles must be covered. Generated .pb.go and .proto files or symlinks require a new review.

review.summary: RC8 first-party source inventory (891 Go files) and all six Go 1.27.2 target closures were independently reviewed. The Linux amd64/arm64 production closures each include all six changed production Go files; each Darwin/Windows target closure includes the changed internal/version/version.go file, while the other five changed production files are outside those target entry-point closures. Actual/original closures match for every target. The selected graph, 106-module production set, go.mod, and go.sum remain unchanged from RC7; generated protobuf source and symlink counts are zero. Existing finding dispositions remain unchanged. This records source/closure applicability only; the official vulnerability scanner, final image, and release have not passed.
